description: A 'significant' improvement with no test and one run must be challenged.

inputs.label: Results notes
inputs.content:
Results (one run each, no seeds repeated):
FedSpec: 74.8% top-1 accuracy
FedAvg baseline: 71.2% top-1 accuracy

Our method significantly outperforms the baseline. The improvement is consistent
and statistically meaningful. We did not run significance tests.
